question: Does exact fit of 32 of the 64 binary six-factor contexts under the unconstrained complete 64-monomial GF(2) numerical basis logically identify ANY unobserved context output, without additional learned/structured causal inductive restrictions?
hypothesis: The complete GF(2) multilinear monomial readout is an invertible 64x64 zeta transform; for every observed subset of 32 distinct contexts and every withheld context q, two different 64-weight programs fit all 32 observed effects exactly yet predict opposite outcomes at q. Construct explicit Kronecker-spike coefficient delta by setting every monomial superset of q. This is a formal identifiability counterexample, NOT a failure of all structured inductive learners.
